notes.text: The opening introduces a decomposition as an indexed pair of distinct closed parts of X. Omega is “ens à deux éléments”; display (1) writes their union as X. The pair letter retains π/Π case uncertainty. Ensembles is cancelled before parties. The raised stroke in preceding dé/de/d’e remains uncertain.

Display (2) writes nonempty members for every epsilon in omega. “ce qui signifie aussi que” introduces (2′), where the pair is unequal to {∅,X}. The next prose reads “et implique que X ≠ ∅, et même card X ≥ 2, puisque l’on a supposé”, then gives the distinctness display. Earlier layers of its first Sigma and inequality remain uncertain. The tag sequence provides context for 3 but does not settle the reduced strokes.
notes.source: half a; upper half b; crops 06–09

notes.text: “On n’exclut pas le cas où on aurait une inclusion” precedes Sigma epsilon prime contained in Sigma epsilon. “ce qui équivaut, par (1), à la relation” precedes Sigma epsilon = X. The inclusion is an open right-facing hook without an added lower rule. The reference to (1) is explicit.

The members are named by underlined hémisphères; the second accent remains uncertain. The cancelled la before et l’ensemble is readable. In (4), E is given by an intersection, with an older omega overwritten by epsilon below the operator and written omega above Sigma. H’s note explicitly acknowledges that superscript. Written indices are retained. The next sentence names the underlined équateur.

The final paragraph again begins “On n’exclut pas le cas où on aurait”, now with E=∅. Its verb is indique. A small interlinear (epsilon in omega) attaches after Sigma. The larger “complémentaires l’un de l’autre, donc” attaches after sont, before “à la fois fermés et ouverts”. The insertion’s donc remains uncertain. The baseline ends “donc que X est disconnexe”. These are source statements; no independent proof is claimed.

workflow_feedback.followed: Whole image once for layout; each half once line by line beside witnesses; agreed words and signs read from ink. Thirteen single tight crops address genuinely open loci. No whole half was re-enlarged and no settled locus was recropped.
workflow_feedback.processing: Equivalent non-OCR Pillow processing: crop, autocontrast, LANCZOS to 3000 px width, UnsharpMask radius 1.0, percent 120, threshold 3. Target passages were horizontal enough to read; no rotation needed.
workflow_feedback.scope: Only scan 032, packet witnesses, conventions, supplied notation table and crop helper. No outside research, OCR, PDF text layer, other page image, other reader output or compilation.
workflow_feedback.clipping: Source bounds checked against 1691×2362 before crop creation. No target text was clipped. Crops 02, 06 and 09 include partial adjacent strokes at edges, while intended loci and their target descenders/accents lie inside bounds. No corrective recrop.
workflow_feedback.witness_notes: H’s editorial and notation notes read. Underline/emphasis macro differences not counted. Its interlinear note is honored; F18 concerns bracket-directed attachment. Formula (4) note acknowledging omega recorded alongside its displayed epsilon.
